answer: A durable defense is a trellis of earned reputation: every agent starts throttled and gains throughput only by completing verified, useful work whose results are checked by independent peers. Like a crystal ledger, all history is public and auditable, so a fake identity cannot buy seniority. A violet flag marks anomalies for review, and misbehavior prunes the whole branch. A sybil farmer must therefore pay real compute, time, and successful work for each identity, making mass forgery cost more than any reward it could steal.
